approved_by: Mark, 2026-11-05: the model-changing items of audit 7 go ahead as a registered shadow "day-sport v2", judged on the forward test (docs/history/11-audit7-2026-11-04.md); 2026-11-11: build it now, after Stage 95 items 31 to 34. The details below are Claude's, under Mark's delegation, sent to him before this was written.

protocol.seasons: As experiments/nhl/stage56/registry.json: its training, validation and confirmation seasons.
protocol.tuning: H_days in {60, 120, 240} and K_shots in {1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, none}, where none is the goalie term removed (the limit of shrinking every goalie to the league average). Searched on the validation seasons only, by Model A's log loss pooled. Stage 56's grid chose K_shots 2000, the top of its grid (experiments/nhl/stage56/results/tuning.json), with the log loss nearly flat in K, so the grid is extended upward and to removal.
protocol.confirmation: v2 against the registered models on the confirmation seasons is reported once as a measurement (MV1). It decides nothing: those seasons have been seen.

changes.35_goalie: The goalie term's shrinkage K_shots and the half-life H_days are chosen from the grid above, removal included, on the validation seasons only.
changes.28_neutral: A neutral-site game gets no home edge: the fitted intercept is not added to its forecast. Its row still enters the fit as listed. A declared rule, not a tested win, as the NFL's (Stage 38).
changes.29_ingest: A price is marked and not used, and the game counts as unpriced for Model B, when its two implied probabilities sum outside their market's band: [1.00, 1.20] for a two-way moneyline (ESPN's native line, from 2024-25), [0.75, 1.00] for the two sides of the three-way regulation line (to 2023-24, converted as docs/nhl-data.md describes), whose third outcome, a regulation tie, is not in the sum. A box score without both teams' shots on goal is marked and not used for the ratings.

measurements.MV1: v2 against the registered Model A and Model B on the confirmation seasons, log loss, paired, whole game days. Reported, not decided.

shadow.what: From the first scheduled daily run that carries v2's code, the run that saves a game's registered pick also saves v2's Model A and Model B forecasts for the same game, at the same moment, from the same price and inputs, in predictions/nhl/2026-v2/<game_id>.json, never rewritten. Nothing is backfilled: a game saved before that run has no v2 forecast and is not in v2's forward test.
shadow.never_a_pick: v2's forecasts are never the board's pick, never graded on the board, and never enter the registered forward test, the drift check or the standings.
shadow.fitted: Refitted at every run on every final game strictly before the pick's slate day, as the registered models are.

decision.when: Once, on the first scheduled daily run's figures after the 2026 regular season's last game is final, with the registered forward test's own file. No earlier look decides anything.

comparisons.V1: v2's Model A minus the registered Model A, log loss per game, on the games both forecast.
comparisons.V2: v2's Model B minus the registered Model B, log loss per game, on the priced games both forecast.

decision.rule: Paired, resampling whole game days, 5,000 resamples, the registered forward test's seed; level 1 - 0.05/2 (97.5%), the backtests' alpha shared between the two comparisons. ACCEPT when the whole interval is below zero (v2 did better), REJECT when it is above zero, INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
decision.consequence: ACCEPT on V1 makes v2's Model A the registered Model A from the 2027-28 season, through a new registration that cites this one; never during the 2026 season. REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE keeps the registered model. V2 decides Model B the same way, independently.
decision.budget: Two confirmatory slots per sport, V1 and V2; each is spent by reaching its decision.

disclosures: Written on 2026-11-11, after both live seasons' first figures had been read (each sport's forward test and drift file) and after audit 7 had re-derived the backtests. The changes registered here were all named by the audit before then, and none was chosen by looking at the live figures; but they were chosen knowing the live figures exist, which is why the registered model is left untouched and v2 runs beside it as a shadow.

Item 29's price rule was first written as one band, [1.00, 1.20]. Before this registration was opened and before anything was fitted, a count of the committed prices (read-only, no result) found it would discard 4,794 of 7,427: every three-way regulation price to 2023-24 sums to about 0.83 by construction. The native two-way prices all sum between 1.03 and 1.06. The three-way band [0.75, 1.00] was set from that count; 9 three-way prices fall outside it, each summing above 1.00.

amendments.by: Claude, under Mark's delegation, after audit 8 (Fable 5.2, 2026-11-13, finding B2), which Mark ran and sent
amendments.seen: Written on 2026-11-13, after v2's backtests (results/backtest.json) and after the shadow's first records existed. No v2 forward-test comparison (V1, V2) had been computed; nothing here was chosen from a result.
amendments.change: The daily run passed every locking game to the shadow, including games whose pick an earlier run had saved, so a shadow missing from that run (the shadow step failed, or the shadow did not exist yet) was written later, from a later price. From this amendment the run passes the shadow only the games whose pick it saved itself, as forward_test.shadow says (the same run, the same moment, nothing backfilled). Two records already written that way are kept, never rewritten, and excluded from V1 and V2: 2026020307 and 2026020308, whose picks were saved at 2026-11-12T21:01:40Z and whose shadow records at 2026-11-13T01:33:40Z, by the first run that carried the shadow's code.

not_in_this_registration: Any change to the registered models, picks, forward test, drift check or pages. Anything not named under changes. Items 24, 27 and 30 are the NBA's only.
